semiconductor_relevance: High — Kyushu University's Yabuta Laboratory conducts advanced research on excimer laser processes specifically for semiconductor materials.
summary: Kyushu University's Yabuta Laboratory focuses on the research and development of excimer laser processes for semiconductor materials, particularly in surface treatment and annealing. They are exploring innovative methods such as Sn doping on Ga2O3 surfaces and laser annealing of transparent conductive films.
capabilities: Excimer laser doping processes for semiconductor surfaces
Laser annealing crystallization of ITO and ZnO:Al films
Surface treatment processes using deep ultraviolet laser irradiation
